generic:mall_violation.speaker: vicky
generic:mall_violation.text: Mall pe gaadi... ab to pakka pakde jaayenge.

generic:snow.speaker: vicky
generic:snow.text: Barf pad rahi hai. Sambhal ke chalana padega.

panga:l1.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l1.text: Aankhein ghar chhod ke aaya kya macho?

panga:l1.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l1.text: Oye bawa, side ho ja thoda.

panga:l1.speaker: dukandaar
panga:l1.text: Be, dhyan se! Saara saamaan gira dega.

panga:l1.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l1.text: Kya be, raasta tere baap ka hai?

panga:l2.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l2.text: Betiyachu, dobara laga to bendaga tod dunga teri!

panga:l2.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l2.text: Bawa, panga mat le. Seedha nikal ja.

panga:l2.speaker: dukandaar
panga:l2.text: Be macho, ab hilaya na to yahin patak dunga.

panga:l2.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l2.text: Ek aur baar laga na be, phir dekhna.

panga:l3.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l3.text: Bawa janta kaun hoon main, macho!

panga:l3.speaker: dukandaar
panga:l3.text: Aaja phir betiyachu, dekh lete hain aaj!

panga:l3.speaker: rahgeer
panga:l3.text: Be, ab tu gaya. Poora bazaar bulaunga.

panga:car.speaker: rahgeer
panga:car.text: Gaadi chalani nahi aati kya be!

panga:car.speaker: dukandaar
panga:car.text: Bawa, licence hai bhi ya aise hi ghuma raha hai?

m01_pehla_din:start.speaker: deepika
m01_pehla_din:start.text: Aa gaya finally. Gate pe khade rehne se attendance nahi lagti.

m01_pehla_din:start.speaker: vicky
m01_pehla_din:start.text: Bheed thi. Photocopy wale ke saamne teesre saal wale khade the.

m01_pehla_din:start.speaker: deepika
m01_pehla_din:start.text: Roz khade rehte hain. Dekhna mat, bas chal.

m01_pehla_din:end.speaker: vicky
m01_pehla_din:end.text: Vicky. Sanjauli se hi hoon sir.

m01_pehla_din:end.speaker: professor
m01_pehla_din:end.text: Sab Sanjauli se hi hain. Dekhte hain tu kitne din rukta hai.

m02_union_parcha:start.speaker: deepika
m02_union_parcha:start.text: Parche laga de campus bhar mein. Sameer ke ladke phaad rahe hain.

m02_union_parcha:start.speaker: deepika
m02_union_parcha:start.text: To phaad denge. Tu bas lagata ja.

m02_union_parcha:end.speaker: sameer
m02_union_parcha:end.text: Naya hai na tu? Naam yaad rakhunga.

m03_court_ka_faisla:start.speaker: professor
m03_court_ka_faisla:start.text: Court par vote hoga. Do sau ladke honge.

m03_court_ka_faisla:start.speaker: professor
m03_court_ka_faisla:start.text: Bhaagna mat. Jo bhaagta hai, usse yahan koi yaad nahi rakhta.

m04_bazaar_ka_hafta:start.speaker: dukandaar
m04_bazaar_ka_hafta:start.text: Beta, tu ab union ka aadmi hai na?

m04_bazaar_ka_hafta:start.speaker: dukandaar
m04_bazaar_ka_hafta:start.text: Har hafte koi aata hai paise lene. Bas ek baar keh de ki nahi dena.

m04_bazaar_ka_hafta:end.speaker: dukandaar
m04_bazaar_ka_hafta:end.text: Aaj koi nahi aaya. Pehli baar.

m05_baudi_ki_chudail:start.speaker: chhotu
m05_baudi_ki_chudail:start.text: Shart lagi thi. Aadhi raat, purani baudi, akele.

m05_baudi_ki_chudail:start.speaker: chhotu
m05_baudi_ki_chudail:start.text: Ek ghanta. Aur bhaag mat jaana, mujhe pata chal jaayega.

m05_baudi_ki_chudail:end.speaker: chudail
m05_baudi_ki_chudail:end.text: Itni raat ko paani bharne aaya hai?

m05_baudi_ki_chudail:end.speaker: chudail
m05_baudi_ki_chudail:end.text: Ja. Aur is baudi ka naam kisi ko mat batana.

m05_baudi_ki_chudail:end.speaker: chhotu
m05_baudi_ki_chudail:end.text: Bhai tu safed pad gaya hai. Kya hua wahan?

m06_igmc_ki_raat:start.speaker: deepika
m06_igmc_ki_raat:start.text: Chhotu ko maara hai unhone. Bazaar ke peeche.

m06_igmc_ki_raat:start.speaker: deepika
m06_igmc_ki_raat:start.text: Gaadi nikaal. IGMC, abhi. Ambulance ka intezaar mat kar.

m06_igmc_ki_raat:end.speaker: vicky
m06_igmc_ki_raat:end.text: Jisne maara hai, usko main jaanta hoon.

m06_igmc_ki_raat:end.speaker: deepika
m06_igmc_ki_raat:end.text: Vicky. Yahin ruk ja. Aage kuch nahi hai.

m07_navbahar_naka:start.speaker: sameer
m07_navbahar_naka:start.text: Ab tu bhi usi taraf hai jidhar main hoon.

m07_navbahar_naka:start.speaker: sameer
m07_navbahar_naka:start.text: Naka laga hai Navbahar pe. Nikal ke dikha.

m07_navbahar_naka:end.speaker: sameer
m07_navbahar_naka:end.text: College mein tujhse ladta tha. Ab tere saath hoon.

m07_navbahar_naka:end.speaker: sameer
m07_navbahar_naka:end.text: Farak ye ki ab upar wale hamare naam jaante hain.

m08_jakhoo_ka_sauda:start.speaker: netaji
m08_jakhoo_ka_sauda:start.text: Upar aa jao. Jakhoo pe baat hoti hai.

m08_jakhoo_ka_sauda:start.speaker: netaji
m08_jakhoo_ka_sauda:start.text: Mall pe sirf tasveer khinchti hai.

m08_jakhoo_ka_sauda:end.speaker: netaji
m08_jakhoo_ka_sauda:end.text: Har das saal mein main ek ladka dhoondta hoon. Is baar tum ho.

m09_mall_ka_julus:start.speaker: netaji
m09_mall_ka_julus:start.text: Bheed teri honi chahiye, naam mera. Abhi ke liye.

m10_vidhan_sabha:start.speaker: netaji
m10_vidhan_sabha:start.text: Aaj tay hoga ki uspe kaun baithega.

m10_vidhan_sabha:end.speaker: vicky
m10_vidhan_sabha:end.text: College ke gate se yahan tak paanch saal lage.

m10_vidhan_sabha:end.speaker: deepika
m10_vidhan_sabha:end.text: Aur us ladke ko yaad hai jo us gate se andar gaya tha?

generic:hit_police.speaker: rahgeer
generic:hit_police.text: Arre! Police pe haath utha diya isne!

vicky:idle:aam.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:aam.text: Macho, aaj to kuch karna hi padega bawa.

vicky:idle:aam.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:aam.text: Bawa yaar, pataka hua pada hoon subah se.

vicky:idle:aam.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:aam.text: Jeb khaali, mahina aadha. Bendiyaba hisaab hai ye.

vicky:idle:aam.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:aam.text: Macho, Sameer ne phir wahi purani baat chhed di.

vicky:idle:aam.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:aam.text: Bedafu, kal wale paise abhi tak nahi aaye.

vicky:idle:aam.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:aam.text: Chal bawa, Sanjauli mein baithe rehne se kuch nahi hota.

vicky:idle:aam.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:aam.text: Amma ne poochha hoga — kahan mara gaya tha. Aur main kya bolun.

vicky:idle:aam.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:aam.text: Ek din is sheher mein naam hoga, bawa. Bas ek din.

vicky:idle:aam.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:aam.text: Baap ki garage khuli hai abhi bhi. Main hi band ho gaya.

vicky:idle:aam.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:aam.text: Macho, chai peene ka mann hai. Paise dekhne ka nahi.

vicky:idle:bazaar.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:bazaar.text: Macho, aaj bazaar mein bheed benduga hai.

vicky:idle:bazaar.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:bazaar.text: Bedafu dukaan wale ne rate phir badha diya.

vicky:idle:bazaar.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:bazaar.text: Bawa, udhaar pe kitna chalega. Ek din kat jaayega.

vicky:idle:bazaar.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:bazaar.text: Chai pe do minute — phir chalte hain.

vicky:idle:bazaar.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:bazaar.text: Yahan har dukaan mein wahi saamaan, bas board alag.

vicky:idle:bazaar.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:bazaar.text: Macho, wo kirane wala mujhe dekh ke andar ghus gaya. Samajh gaya kya chakkar hai.

vicky:idle:college.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:college.text: Macho, Shilpa ne ganda hi kata mera. RKMV wali, bendiyaba.

vicky:idle:college.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:college.text: Bawa, us RKMV wali pe vishwas karne layak nahi tha.

vicky:idle:college.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:college.text: Attendance kam hai. Thakur Sir ne dekh liya to kat gaya samajh.

vicky:idle:college.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:college.text: Class chal rahi hai andar, aur main gate pe khada hoon. Macho.

vicky:idle:college.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:college.text: Deepika ne bola tha library mein milna. Bhool gaya bedafu.

vicky:idle:college.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:college.text: Bawa, padhai aur politics — dono ek saath nahi chalti yaar.

vicky:idle:college.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:college.text: Photocopy wale ke saamne teesre saal wale phir khade hain.

vicky:idle:college.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:college.text: Macho, notes kisi se maangne padenge. Apne to hain hi nahi.

vicky:idle:raat.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:raat.text: Bawa, raat ko Sanjauli aur chhoti lagti hai.

vicky:idle:raat.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:raat.text: Kutte bhaunk rahe hain. Matlab koi aa raha hai.

vicky:idle:raat.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:raat.text: Macho, itni raat ko bhi log baahar hain. Benduga sheher hai.

vicky:idle:raat.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:raat.text: Ghar jaana chahiye. Par abhi nahi bawa.

vicky:idle:raat.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:raat.text: Andhere mein raasta yaad se chalta hai, aankhon se nahi.

vicky:idle:raat.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:raat.text: Bedafu, phone ki battery bhi ab hi khatam honi thi.

vicky:idle:thanda.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:thanda.text: Bedafu, kat gaya. Mausam itna benduga aaj.

vicky:idle:thanda.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:thanda.text: Bawa, barf pad rahi hai. Sadak band ho jaayegi.

vicky:idle:thanda.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:thanda.text: Haath sunn ho gaye. Beedi jalani padegi ab.

vicky:idle:thanda.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:thanda.text: Macho, is mausam mein gaadi chalana bewakoofi hai.

vicky:idle:thanda.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:thanda.text: Shimla ki sardi haddi tak jaati hai bawa. Sach mein.

vicky:idle:thanda.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:thanda.text: Sweater andar hai, main baahar. Bendiyaba planning meri.

vicky:idle:police.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:police.text: Bedafu, police peeche lag gayi. Bhaag ab.

vicky:idle:police.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:police.text: Macho, ek galti aur — seedha chowki.

vicky:idle:police.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:police.text: Bawa, aaj chowki mein raat nahi katni.

vicky:idle:police.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:police.text: Bhaag Vicky, sochna baad mein bendiyaba.

vicky:idle:police.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:police.text: Inko abhi hi mera chehra yaad aana tha. Benduga kismat.

vicky:idle:thaka.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:thaka.text: Saans phool gayi bawa. Ye chadhai jaan le legi.

vicky:idle:thaka.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:thaka.text: Macho, do minute. Pahad kahin bhaag nahi raha.

vicky:idle:thaka.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:thaka.text: Bedafu, ab aur nahi. Baith jaata hoon.

vicky:idle:thaka.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:thaka.text: Pataka hua pada hoon. Thoda ruk yaar.

vicky:idle:gaadi.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:gaadi.text: Gaadi purani hai bawa, par chalti hai.

vicky:idle:gaadi.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:gaadi.text: Macho, Mall pe gaadi le gaya to police pakka aayegi.

vicky:idle:gaadi.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:gaadi.text: Horn maaro, warna yahan koi hatega nahi.

vicky:idle:gaadi.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:gaadi.text: Mod tez hai — dhyan se bawa.

vicky:idle:gaadi.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:gaadi.text: Bedafu ne beech sadak pe gaadi khadi kar di.

vicky:idle:kaam.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:kaam.text: Kaam adhoora hai bawa. Chal ab.

vicky:idle:kaam.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:kaam.text: Marker udhar hai. Pahunchna hai macho.

vicky:idle:kaam.speaker: vicky
vicky:idle:kaam.text: Der ho rahi hai. Log intezaar nahi karte bawa.

vicky:chori.speaker: vicky
vicky:chori.text: Macho, gaadi to le li. Ab bhaag bawa.

vicky:chori.speaker: vicky
vicky:chori.text: Bedafu, chabhi andar hi chhod gaya tha!

vicky:chori.speaker: vicky
vicky:chori.text: Sorry bawa, kaam zaroori hai. Wapas kar dunga… shayad.

vicky:chori.speaker: vicky
vicky:chori.text: Benduga, ab poora Sanjauli dekh raha hai.

crowd:gossip1.speaker: buddha
crowd:gossip1.text: Macho, suna? Raat ko tendua ghus gya Sanjauli, upar wale mohalle mein.

crowd:gossip1.speaker: chhora
crowd:gossip1.text: Bawa ji, kutte ko utha le gaya seedha. Bendaga faad di bechare ki.

crowd:gossip2.speaker: dukandaar
crowd:gossip2.text: Bedafu, sabji mandi mein kya hua pata hai?

crowd:gossip2.speaker: rahgeer
crowd:gossip2.text: Haan yaara, do bando ki bendaga tod di ek dusre ne. Tamatar ke daam pe.

crowd:gossip3.speaker: chhora
crowd:gossip3.text: Bawa ji yaara, kisko de re is baar vote?

crowd:gossip3.speaker: buddha
crowd:gossip3.text: Jo sadak banwa de macho, usi ko. Baaki sab ek jaise hain.

crowd:gossip4.speaker: aunty
crowd:gossip4.text: Macho, bandar chhat pe se saara raashan le gaye.

crowd:gossip4.speaker: dukandaar
crowd:gossip4.text: Bedafu, Jakhoo wale to poora thaila hi utha le jaate hain.

crowd:gossip5.speaker: rahgeer
crowd:gossip5.text: Light gayi phir se bawa. Teesri baar aaj.

crowd:gossip5.speaker: dukandaar
crowd:gossip5.text: Board wale so rahe hain macho. Inverter chaalu kar.

crowd:gossip6.speaker: chhora
crowd:gossip6.text: Bedafu, mausam itna benduga ho gaya achanak.

crowd:gossip6.speaker: buddha
crowd:gossip6.text: Bawa, upar barf padi hai kal raat. Kufri thanda ho gaya.

crowd:gossip7.speaker: buddha
crowd:gossip7.text: Macho, is baar seb ka daam achha mila?

crowd:gossip7.speaker: dukandaar
crowd:gossip7.text: Kya bataun yaara, peti ka rate hi gir gaya. Mandi wale kha gaye.

crowd:gossip8.speaker: rahgeer
crowd:gossip8.text: Bus late hai phir se. Aadha ghanta ho gaya bawa.

crowd:gossip8.speaker: chhora
crowd:gossip8.text: Driver chai pe gaya hoga guru dhaba pe. Aa jayega macho.

crowd:gossip9.speaker: chhora
crowd:gossip9.text: Macho, RKMV ki chhutti ho gayi. Bheed lag gayi bazaar mein.

crowd:gossip9.speaker: buddha
crowd:gossip9.text: Bawa, tu bhi na. Chal apna kaam kar.

crowd:gossip10.speaker: rahgeer
crowd:gossip10.text: Bedafu, upar ka raasta band hai. Malba gir gaya barish mein.

crowd:gossip10.speaker: aunty
crowd:gossip10.text: Bawa ji, ab ghoom ke jaana padega. Do ghante extra.

crowd:gossip11.speaker: chhora
crowd:gossip11.text: Macho, kal match dekha? Aakhri over mein haar gaye.

crowd:gossip11.speaker: rahgeer
crowd:gossip11.text: Bedafu, poochh mat. Paise laga diye the maine.

crowd:gossip12.speaker: buddha
crowd:gossip12.text: Chal bawa, ek chai ho jaye guru dhaba pe.

crowd:gossip12.speaker: chhora
crowd:gossip12.text: Haan yaara, is thand mein chai se badhiya kuch nahi.
